difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that given the data and the first four axioms there is a unique rule assigning to every smooth projective scheme a graded ring homomorphism from the rational Chow ring to the sum of the even twists of the cohomology, compatible with pullbacks and intertwining the classical Chern character with the Chern character of the theory (statement lines 4712-4721). The proof (proof lines 4722-4758) defines the map through the isomorphism between K theory and Chow groups, checks pullback compatibility, and uses the second Adams operator for gradedness. H3: a construction with a gradedness argument through Adams operations, written out in full.
